name: com.uee03.pretzel.multiplayer
description: A session facade over Netcode for GameObjects and Unity Multiplayer Services (Sessions + Relay): local couch co-op, online host/join/quick-join, cross-play tagging, rejoin with backoff, a pooled network spawn handler, a drop-in UI Toolkit menu and a two-cube sample.

samples.description: Two networked cubes that can only move, jump and turn, plus Spawn Item and Delete Items buttons that use the pooled spawn handler. Works in local co-op, online host/join and quick-join through the drop-in menu. Create the scene with Pretzel > Samples > Multiplayer.
